en: The image is an old sepia-toned postcard featuring a large building complex with a prominent church tower. The tower has a clock, arched windows, and an onion-shaped dome topped with a cross. The building is surrounded by a low wall and trees, and in the foreground, there are nets spread out on the ground, possibly for drying fish or agricultural products. The style of architecture and the church tower suggest Central or Eastern European influence.
